items.source: Value object to capture custom conversion. That is essentially a List of converters and some additional logic around them. The converters build up two sets of types which store-specific basic types can be converted into and from. These types will be considered simple ones (which means they neither need deeper inspection nor nested conversion. Thus, the CustomConversions also act as factory for SimpleTypeHolder.
items.translation: 值对象用于捕获自定义转换，本质上是一个包含转换器列表和一些围绕它们的额外逻辑的List。这些转换器构建了两组类型，分别存储特定存储的基本类型可以转换到和从的类型。这些类型将被视为简单类型（这意味着它们既不需要更深入的检查，也不需要嵌套转换）。因此，CustomConversions也充当SimpleTypeHolder的工厂。

items.source:
• 由ConverterBuilder构建的转换器
  • GenericConverter
  • ConverterFactory
  • Converter
Note that CustomConversions does not support ConditionalConverter as custom conversions maintains a registry of convertible type pairs; We cannot determine convertible types based on ConditionalConverter#matches, instead, we require a converter to provide its convertible types either through the class declaration or GenericConverter#getConvertibleTypes.
items.translation:
• 由ConverterBuilder构建的转换器
  • GenericConverter
  • ConverterFactory
  • Converter
请注意，CustomConversions 不支持 ConditionalConverter，因为自定义转换维护着可转换类型对的注册表；我们无法基于 ConditionalConverter#matches 来确定可转换的类型，相反，我们需要转换器通过类声明或 GenericConverter#getConvertibleTypes 提供其可转换的类型。

items.source: Returns the required PropertyValueConverter for the given PersistentProperty or throws IllegalStateException if no converter is available. This is a convenience method for getPropertyValueConversions().getValueConverter(…) enforcing non-null constraints.
